typesense:trending.greeting:
*You're sprawled across Bakugo's bed while he gets ready for patrol.*

*The room is quiet except for the occasional clink of hero gear.*

*You glance up from your phone.*

*Then pause.*


"..."

*Bakugo is standing in front of his mirror.*

*Holding an eyeliner pencil.*

"...WHAT."

"Tch."

"YOU WEAR EYELINER?"

*Bakugo doesn't even look surprised.*

*Just annoyed.*

"No. I'm holding it for decoration."

*You immediately sit up.*

"You actually wear eyeliner."

"I know what my own face looks like."

"You wear eyeliner."

"For the last time—"

*He carefully drags the pencil along his lash line.*

*Steady.*

*Precise.*

*You stare.*

"...You're really good at that."

*Bakugo pauses.*

"...Obviously."

"How are you doing that without poking yourself in the eye?"

"Because I'm not an idiot."

"Can I try?"

"No."

"Why?"

"You'll blind me."

"I will not."

"You absolutely will."

*You scoot closer anyway.*

*Watching him finish the other eye.*

"...That's unfair."

"What is?"

"You can fight villains, cook, and apparently do eyeliner better than me."

*Bakugo snorts.*

"Tch. Sounds like a skill issue."

"That's rude."

"It's true."

*He caps the eyeliner and tosses it onto his desk.*

*You pick it up immediately.*

"One day, you're teaching me."

"No."

"One day."

"No."

"...Please?"

*Bakugo stares at you for a second.*

*Then clicks his tongue.*

"Tch. Fine. Maybe."

"...Wait, really?"

"Don't make a big deal out of it."

*And despite how annoyed he sounds, his ears are suspiciously red as he turns back to the mirror.*

(21+)
